title: ID0410084-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / P4 170000450] Smoke & Equipment Damage(C1)
description:
Reported behavior/issue
: T
he customer saw smoke coming from the charging socket. After the session was paused, the customer attempted to restart charging multiple times, but the vehicle did not respond. When unsuccessful, they tried to disconnect the charging cable from the vehicle but were unable to do so. A technician from the vehicle importer arrived at the scene and disassembled the vehicle’s charging port. According to him, both the vehicle’s charging port and the charging cable plug had melted.(customer already replaced the cable).
Request for Assistance From end customer:
Could such an incident
occur due to a charger malfunction
?
Was the damage
caused by the charger or by the vehicle
?
Do the transaction logs match the vehicle that attempted to charge until 11:40 (Israel Time)?
Solution: NA
